single_dose: 7.5 mg/kg (3X the recommended dose) can result in pulmonary inflammation, edema, and death
mechanism_of_action: unknown mode of action on D. immitis
side_effects: tremors, lethargy, unsteadiness/ataxia, restlessness, panting, shallow and labored respiration, rales, collapse, severe salivation, vomiting, respiratory distress, cyanosis, stupor, death within 4 hours of the first dose in two dogs and within 20 hours of the second dose in one dog
unsuitable_population: dogs with very severe (Class 4) heartworm disease, patients with renal impairment
